Name: Ace's Expanded Houses (Content Patcher)
Author: acerbicon
Description:
[center][b][size=2]Ace's Expanded Houses[/size][/b]
Are you tired of your house being too small? Of not having enough space
for all the things you want to show off? Then act now, because, for the low, low cost
of FREE, you can have Robin expand your houses without lifting a finger yourself!

*Screenshots may not match your house appearance in some cases, modified tilesheets will affect the appearance*


[size=2][size=2][b]REQUIREMENTS:[/b][/size][size=2][b] [/b]
[url=http://www.smapi.io/][/url][url=http://smapi.io/][/url][url=http://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿
[/size][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2323/]Ace's Building Tilesheets[/url]﻿

[/size][/size][size=2][b]HOW TO INSTALL:[/b][/size]
1[size=2]. Download the file you want
2. Unzip into "Mods" f[/size]older.
3. Play the game and enjoy your new house!


ADVANCED EDITING:
If you want to change your bed, kitchen, and/or crib in the house upgrades go to the
Assets folder of the [CP] Ace's House mod folder. Inside, simply edit the [b]farmhouse_tiles.png[/b]
to change your bed, kitchen, and/or crib's appearance.[/center]

Downloads.Description:
Tentative 1.5 compatibility. Should be compatible with Multiple Spouses.


Bed in the married version of the second house upgrade should be completely moveable with no extra left behind and the unmarried first upgrade will move to the attic. Tub useable.
